source_evidence: Coder A construction check: PMLR v206 main §3.2 serialization definitions (List Only Values; List Permuted Names: same permutation across all examples; List Permuted Values: one permutation per column applied to all examples, continuous values first cut into ten uniform bins) + §5.1 results; Coder B construction evidence: TabLLM §3.2: List Permuted Values applies one fixed per-column permutation to all values; for continuous values ten uniform bins are used.
final_rationale: Beyond the semantic manipulation, the comparator also changes the granularity of the data: continuous values are discretized into ten uniform bins before the per-column permutation is applied, while the base List Template carries the raw values. Predictive information other than semantic content therefore changes as well, so the contrast does not isolate content sensitivity. For purely categorical datasets the same construction would be a clean content control.
